ops.desktopOnly: These options are only available in the desktop app
ops.closeToTray: Minimize to tray when closing the window
ops.closeToTrayHint: After closing, LULUX stays in the system tray so schedules and mailbox sync keep running. To quit, choose Quit from the tray icon menu.
ops.closeToTrayMac: On macOS the app keeps running in the Dock after closing the window; with this on, the window hides to the menu bar icon. Quit with ⌘Q or Quit in the menu bar icon.
ops.trayUnavailable: This desktop environment has no system tray, so the window can't be minimized to it.
ops.launchAtLoginHint: Start LULUX when you sign in to your computer (it starts in the tray when minimize-to-tray is on), so schedules run on time.
ops.launchAtLoginDev: Launch at login isn't available in development builds; use an installed build.
ops.updErrNetwork: Couldn't reach the update server. Check your network or proxy and try again. If GitHub is unreliable on your network, set a company mirror as the update source below.
ops.updErrNetworkCustom: Couldn't reach the update source you set. Make sure the address is reachable (a company intranet may need VPN).
ops.updErrNotFound: No release information (latest.yml) was found on the update server; a release may not be published yet.
ops.updErrNotFoundCustom: No latest.yml was found at the update source. Make sure the address points to the folder holding the installers and latest*.yml.
ops.updErrForbidden: The update server refused access (401/403 or rate limit). Try again later or use a mirror.
ops.updErrBadFeed: The update information is malformed or the installer checksum failed. Ask the publisher to check the update source.
ops.feedHint: Optional. A folder on a company mirror or CDN that holds the installers and latest*.yml; it replaces the default GitHub source. Leave empty to use the default.
ops.diagSub: When something goes wrong, send a diagnostics bundle to support. It holds recent logs plus version and system info; passwords, tokens and keys are masked, and the customer database isn't included.
ops.diagLocalHint: Logs from the local service and the desktop app (last 3 days)
ops.serverLogsHint: Download the team server's logs from the last 3 days (owners and admins only)

teamLifecycle.handoverSub: Customers (with their quotes, deals, orders and open tasks) go to the receiver; email accounts, workflows and schedules follow the choices below
teamLifecycle.schedulesHint: Schedules will then run as the receiver, with the receiver's permissions. Schedules that appended to the leaver's private chat will start a new chat each run.
teamLifecycle.disableMessage: Signs the member out on every device and pauses their schedules and background email sync. Data is kept and everything resumes when re-enabled; you can also hand their work over first.
teamLifecycle.resetHint: Share it through a secure channel. They must change it to a password only they know the next time they sign in.
teamLifecycle.createSub: Set an initial password instead of sending an invite link; they must change it at first sign-in
teamLifecycle.name: Name
teamLifecycle.initialHint: Share it through a secure channel. They'll be asked to choose their own password at first sign-in.
teamLifecycle.createRequired: Enter an email and a name
teamLifecycle.created: Added {0}; they must change the password at first sign-in
teamLifecycle.emailMode_disable: Stop background sync (accounts stay with the current owner)
